name: Still Here
tagline: One tap a day; miss it and an escalation chain alerts your contacts and, finally, a wellness check.
problem: Millions of people live alone, and nobody notices if something happens to them.
solution: A daily check-in; missing it triggers push and email, a configurable grace period, texts to contacts and a non-emergency wellness request.
demo_moment: Team-described: skip a check-in and watch the escalation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Netcore - Netcore” among 223 submissions.
The whole product is one action.

lessons: A one-action product is easy to trust and explain.
